title: drogna publisher configuration
description: Configuration for C-14, the publisher. Partial visibility is the failure this component owns: everything here exists so that making a run visible is one operation on one volume, and so that the names a run is servable under are derived from the store's layout rather than enumerated in a collection file. The common sections are referenced from config.common.schema.json rather than restated.

staging.title: Where completed runs are collected from
staging.description: The same location the model runner writes into, on the same volume as the catalogue, because a move across volumes is a copy and a copy is not indivisible.

catalogue.title: The coverage store's layout
catalogue.description: A directory per run under a root, with the current run named by a pointer that is replaced in one operation. The layout is the query layer's to define; these are the names this component needs in order to write into it.

runs_dirname.description: The subdirectory of the store root that holds the runs. The layout gives a run directory no prefix of its own — the directory is the run identifier, and the identifier already begins with the prefix its own rule states — so this names the directory they sit in. It replaces run_directory_prefix, which carried this value for want of a key of its own and which could not be empty.

current_pointer.description: Name of the entry in the root that resolves to the current run's directory.

partial_suffix.description: What an in-flight name ends in. Anything under it is invisible to the catalogue, which is what lets a run be assembled and a pointer be replaced without a reader ever seeing either half-made. It states the same value as query.coverage_store.partial_suffix and the model runner's staging.partial_suffix; three statements rather than one because no component reads another's configuration.

collections.title: The served collection
collections.description: The fixed identifier the query layer serves runs under, stated here so the announcement can carry it (decided 28 August 2026, issue #34). One collection carries the forecast parameters and the uncertainty parameter together; the current run answers at the collection itself, and a specific run is an EDR instance of it named by the run identifier. Until that decision the identifiers were derived per run by prefix, which produced names nothing served.

forecast.description: The collection identifier exactly as the query layer serves it. It states the same value the query configuration declares; two statements rather than one because no component reads another's configuration.
